# @trysac/openapi-mock

> Pure mock HTTP handler generated from an OpenAPI 3.0.x or 3.1.x document, with example and schema-derived bodies, RFC 7240 Prefer control (code and example), seeded 500 injection, RFC 9457 problem responses and an optional loopback node:http server. TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage, API and limits
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions and limits for contributors and agents
